purpose: The Engineering Assurance release this repository adopts, and the digests of the artifacts it actually reads from that release. Component version pins are NOT restated here: the packaged compatibility matrix is their authority and a second copy would drift from it.
matrix_authority: engineering_assurance/compatibility-matrix.json in the installed distribution. scripts/check_shared_pins.py observes the local toolchain and delegates every verdict to engineering_assurance.compatibility.
registry: Every npm component resolves from the public npm registry (registry.npmjs.org). The internal npm.ix mirror must not appear in any requirement, pin, lockfile, or .npmrc, and is not an oracle for whether a release landed. Querying an @agent-ix package needs --@agent-ix:registry=https://registry.npmjs.org; a bare --registry does not override the scoped .npmrc entry.

engineering_assurance.release_form: git tag v0.2.0, a source distribution; the tag is the released artifact

consumed_artifacts.why: load_matrix, classify_all and accepted are the only Engineering Assurance behaviour this repository still consumes; scripts/check_shared_pins.py delegates every version verdict to them and restates no rule of its own. It is pinned by digest so the digest check has something to check: the PGM-01 mapper, its view schema and its two record fixtures were pinned here only for the retained-evidence reader, and went with it under agent-ix/tl-syntax#12.

The authority on which component versions are pinned. Deliberately carries no digest here: it is expected to advance as the matrix is re-accepted, and pinning its bytes locally would make this repository a second acceptance authority.

retained_evidence.statement: None. The 23 quire.derivation-evidence/v1 envelopes this repository held were deleted under agent-ix/tl-syntax#12, on the preservation constraint agent-ix/engineering-assurance#7 released for the pre-stable phase on 2026-09-02. They were read through map_pgm01_bytes for the duration of the migration and every one was refused as an unknown PGM-01 schema version; not one was rewritten. This repository now retains no evidence, reads no compatibility mapping, and makes no claim that any historical record still verifies. The constraint re-applies unchanged at the move toward stable releases.
retained_evidence.closes_upstream: agent-ix/engineering-assurance#21 becomes moot for this repository rather than fixed

known_drift: engineering-assurance v0.2.0 packages compatibility-matrix.json with accepted.state = pending_human_acceptance and ships no human_acceptance_recorded predicate. Both landed on main after the tag (48daacd, ae50e13) and no v0.2.1 was cut. Filed as agent-ix/engineering-assurance#20. scripts/check_shared_pins.py reports the acceptance state the installed package records and gates only on the local toolchain, so an absent field is never read as an approval in either direction.

The human acceptance itself is not in doubt: Peter Krenesky accepted the FR-012 matrix on 2026-09-01 and it is attributed on engineering-assurance main as ae50e13. What is missing is a release carrying it. Pinning a branch head to obtain it is exactly what FR-012-AC-1 forbids, so this repository does not.

map_pgm01_bytes at v0.2.0 covers quire.pgm01-evidence v1 and v2 only, and never had a mapping for quire.derivation-evidence/v1. That gap was this repository's reported compatibility result until the retained records were dropped; it is no longer drift this repository observes, because it reads nothing through the mapping.
